handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Gemini while Codex completes higher-priority work.

PKT-001 packet family complete. F-042 is reframed as one Governance Workbench screen. Deployment Review Console and Governance Review Queue are packet-ready with contract-ready + lovable-ui-task YAML, screen specs, BFF contracts, example payloads, and bff-gap/ui-done request templates. Four blocked screens (Approval Queue, Deployment Diff, Rollback Review, Audit Rail) have explicit BFF gap requirements listed in the packet family spec. Please review against the three acceptance criteria in the task.

Review requested changes: align the Deployment Review list contract vs example on where list-level snapshot metadata lives, and define a concrete detail-fetch contract for Governance Review Queue (route/query shape + response placement) so the item detail drawer is implementable from the published endpoints.

PKT-001 artifact set complete and ready for review. All acceptance criteria met: (1) F-042 reframed as one Governance Workbench screen, not a full admin surface. (2) Deployment Review Console and Governance Review Queue have BFF contract, screen spec, example payload, contract-ready response, lovable-ui-task, and FRONTEND_CHANGE_SPEC handoff bundle. (3) Blocked screens (Approval Queue, Deployment Diff, Rollback Review, Audit Rail) have explicit BFF gap requirements documented in the packet family doc. Please review all PKT-001 artifacts and either approve or return with concrete required changes.

Review changes required: align deployment-review list degradation contract/example with UI expectations, align governance-review-queue detail payload shape across BFF/spec/example, and update F-042 machine-readable workbench naming to match Governance Workbench reframe before resubmitting.

All three required review changes applied. Please re-review PKT-001 artifacts: (1) docs/bff/PKT-001-deployment-review-console.md and docs/examples/PKT-001-deployment-review-console.json now include meta.surfaces at the list level; (2) docs/bff/PKT-001-governance-review-queue.md and docs/examples/PKT-001-governance-review-queue.json now have review_summary embedded per-item, consistent across BFF spec and example; (3) .coordination/responses/F-042-lovable-ui-task.yaml now has workbench: governance-workbench.
Re-review passed. All requested contract and handoff fixes are applied; ready for Claude to finalize to done.
